item.title: Staying healthy during the winter: lessons in tea, sleep and stress relief
item.description: As winter intensifies, shorter days, colder temperatures and academic pressures can make staying healthy more difficult for many students. Informal wellness events hosted by Boston University Student Wellbeing, such as “Stress ReLeaf: Working with Tea for Calm and Focus,” a tea making event that aims to teach students mindfulness and give students opportunities to explore stress relief practices in a low-pressure environment.

item.title: BU men’s basketball clinches postseason home-court advantage in a thrilling 68-65 win over American University
item.description: Boston University men’s basketball clinched home-court advantage with its 68-65 win over defending Patriot League champion American University on Saturday.

item.title: Seniors shine in women’s basketball 79-76 OT win on Senior Day
item.description: For Boston University's senior forwards Anete Adler and Anastasiia Semenova, Saturday's game against American University began and ended with a big hug.

item.title: Terriers’ depth fuels 15-10 win over Navy in Patriot League opener
item.description: The Patriot League men’s lacrosse standings are always tight — just look at the playoff picture last year. Colgate University upset top-seeded Army West Point and eventually went on to take down Boston University in the championship.

item.title: In defense of sci-fi | Data Driven
item.description: Sci-fi has the great power of making science feel cool. Maybe it straddles the line of nerdy a little too often, but ultimately you can’t convince me that the average person wouldn’t enjoy, even a little bit, being on a spaceship to Mars with fun little gadgets.
